measured_2026-09-20: identical 3 systems (1code, a-b-agent, ace), 114 cells each run
why: Sonnet leaves 76 of 114 cells unresolved against Opus's 45-49 on the same bundles: it answers 'not reported' far more often, which would bias the under-reporting rate that is itself a result. Low effort matches default effort on resolution at a third of the cost. Caching is a pure loss here: every call writes its whole prompt to cache (cache_write = tokens_in) and never reads it back, because each system's evidence bundle is unique.
